subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a general N-turn model lease contract, and if so should it live only in `/model --turns` or also in Gateway/session APIs as the broader form of the one-turn override work?
rationale: The implementation would add new user-facing command syntax, persisted session state semantics, provider/auth routing behavior, and a new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API contract.

options.title: Design unified model lease
options.body: Add a general lease model that covers one-turn and N-turn overrides, then implement command, Gateway/session API, warning, revert, validation, docs, and tests against that single contract.

options.title: Keep one-turn only for now
options.body: Let #83565 and its candidate PRs solve the narrower atomic one-turn drift problem, and leave multi-turn governance out of core until cost controls become a current priority.

options.title: Reject core turn budgets
options.body: Close this as outside core and steer teams to external policy or plugin-level governance if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own cost-budget semantics.

recommendation.title: Design unified model lease
recommendation.body: Add a general lease model that covers one-turn and N-turn overrides, then implement command, Gateway/session API, warning, revert, validation, docs, and tests against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior model override/auth/session routing work across the central files this decision would touch.
